VERDICT goal: The source node's goal is to report terminal, unpromoted runs whose owning session has no live follower and no dispatch past a threshold, as a forgotten crew read view in reckon/crew/forgotten_runs.py; this delta (0904d78f1..84e23103f) closes the "unpromoted" half of that predicate by adding the settled-run case at tests/test_forgotten_runs_are_reported.py:254.
VERDICT done_when: the source done-when (prompt FENCE-EVIDENCE) names tests/test_forgotten_runs_are_reported.py plus both arms from git checkouts; the delta's new case is inside the head-arm command (logs/head-arm.log ran tests/test_forgotten_runs_are_reported.py at 560266378, recording 148 passed / 1 failed), and I independently re-ran that file at 84e23103f for 5 passed.
VERDICT write_paths: the declared write paths are reckon/crew/forgotten_runs.py, reckon/mcp_views.py, tests/test_forgotten_runs_are_reported.py, docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-shows-the-work-it-watches/a-run-nobody-returns-to-is-reported.html and docs/figures/the-monitor-shows-the-work-it-watches/a-run-nobody-returns-to-is-reported; both delta files sit on the list and the diff touches nothing else.
VERDICT manifest: read; status complete, commits edb6994bacdb8332da592bd015204c6ff54b667a, 5602663780a093a8bcd8273576ad95ea88f2182d and 84e23103f are listed, the landing states "5 cases pass and the view names exactly the one forgotten pointer of five", and retry_failures attributes the view-parity flake to parallel-run timing.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit; edb6994ba adds the settled-run case and _landed helper, 560266378 reflows one assertion message, 84e23103f rewrites the fragment's measure, negative-control and gate paragraphs; both changed paths are inside the declared write paths.
CALL_SITES: reckon/mcp_views.py:4029, reckon/mcp_views.py:3612, reckon/_mcp_tools.py:99
SCORE goal_fidelity: 18
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: tests/test_forgotten_runs_are_reported.py:254 lands the "unpromoted" half the goal names; the delta adds coverage, not production behaviour.
SCORE evidence: 18
JUSTIFICATION evidence: logs/head-arm.log records 148 passed / 1 failed at 560266378 and logs/negative-control-unpromoted.log shows the added case reddening under the mutation; the source manifest.md carries no baseline_suite/after_suite keys, so the two arm logs were read directly and my re-run of tests/test_forgotten_runs_are_reported.py at 84e23103f gave 5 passed.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: both paths in git diff 0904d78f1..84e23103f (tests/test_forgotten_runs_are_reported.py and the evidence fragment) are among the manifest's orientation_write_paths.
SCORE durability: 19
JUSTIFICATION durability: the assertions at tests/test_forgotten_runs_are_reported.py:269-279 compare fixed run-id constants against a derived list, and logs/negative-control-unpromoted.log shows them reddening when reckon/crew/forgotten_runs.py:_terminal_unpromoted is bypassed, so the case fails if the classifier's settled overwrite at reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:1616 regresses.
SCORE fit: 19
JUSTIFICATION fit: tests/test_forgotten_runs_are_reported.py:148 _landed and :254 the new case follow the file's existing _pointer/fixture idiom and carry no plan or ticket identifier.
SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: _landed delegates to ledger.write_run_file (the owner) rather than reimplementing row serialisation, and no existing test helper owns "persist a run row".
